verdict.rationale: Raygun's own AI Error Resolution feature gives users an in-product natural-language chat, built on OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, for diagnosing and fixing individual errors. The evidence shows this as an error-diagnosis conversation, not as a way to issue commands that operate the product. The official MCP server belongs to a separate MCP story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that perform product actions (resolving or ignoring errors, filtering, configuring alerts), coverage beyond error diagnosis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can chat with this tool collaboratively.
This feature allows you to identify and tackle errors swiftly with just a click, using advanced AI technology powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
Simply press the comment button in the AI chat, and it will create a link back to your conversation to be posted into the comments section.
